commit e324096f90e6393cbc96a1c79cb3ee5c3070c81d
Author:     John Bieling <john@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Wed May 6 22:23:03 2026 +0000
Commit:     John Bieling <john@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Wed May 6 22:23:03 2026 +0000

    Bug 2036916 - Change lifetime of preference metrics. r= thunderbird-data-reviewers,mkmelin
    
    We observed glean pings with missing values for some preference metrics. This originally
    surfaced for the `hasExperimentInstalled` and `hasExtensionInstalled` prefs:
    
    https://sql.telemetry.mozilla.org/queries/112617#289522
    
    This is however not limited to these, but other metric from the same group [1] show similar
    if not identical behavior:
    
    https://sql.telemetry.mozilla.org/queries/119206/source#291033
    
    The conclusion from the glean team (Travis and Chutten) is to switch the lifetime of our pings
    to "application", to get rid of empty metric pings when the app is running longer than a day.
    This documentation has some insights:
    
    https://mozilla.github.io/glean/book/user/metrics/adding-new-metrics.html#a-lifetime-example
    
    The core feedback from the glean team are:
    - We do not record metrics on-change
    - Whenever a metric value was sent with a metric ping, its value is cleared.
    - The standard "ping" lifetime will not re-recorded the pref status for the lifetime
      of the application runtime (metric included in one metric ping per app startup)
    - Switching to the "application" lifetime will re-record the pref status on every
      metric ping  (metric included in all metric pings)
    
    A metrics file from Firefox with that configuration: https://searchfox.org/firefox-main/rev/a353242aeafd56b2c21a2c0672ecb51ea1b81142/browser/components/metrics.yaml#1089-1107
    
    1: https://searchfox.org/comm-central/rev/5b7584f41926a5eba6bf17ff06550b7843608483/mail/metrics.yaml#176,182-183
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D298407

diff --git a/mail/metrics.yaml b/mail/metrics.yaml
index 0ae3f0de713..368ce3ddc3f 100644
--- a/mail/metrics.yaml
+++ b/mail/metrics.yaml
@@ -160,6 +160,7 @@ mail:
 
   preferences_boolean:
     type: labeled_boolean
+    lifetime: application
     description: Values of boolean preferences.
     bugs:
       - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1757993
@@ -266,6 +267,7 @@ mail:
 
   preferences_integer:
     type: labeled_string
+    lifetime: application
     description: Values of integer preferences.
     bugs:
       - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1800775
title: Bug 2036916 - Change lifetime of preference metrics. r= thunderbird-data-reviewers,mkmelin
